versions.changelog: 默认返回最终采集结果，完善异步等待下载与安全恢复；修复空目标误执行、Quick Start、Token 配置和触发路由冲突，并补齐发布前自动化测试
新增能力路由与异步任务闭环，修复失效引用、Token 泄漏和 Skill 元数据兼容性
补全中文文档，更新目录结构

Initial release providing Facebook post comment collection via Dataify Builder.

- Allows users to submit Facebook post URLs to collect comments, supporting both single and multiple group collection.
- Full interactive workflow: confirms required/optional parameters with Markdown tables, including dropdown options.
- Intelligent Dataify API TOKEN management: prompts for input and optionally saves token securely, with clear instructions for Windows shell.
- Validates all fields (URL, dropdown values, numeric fields) before submission.
- Uses a provided Python script for stable job submission.
- Returns the task ID and status, guiding users to https://dataify.com/dashboard/ to view results.
